id.intro: PT. Retech Digital Solution (RETECH) adalah partner teknologi B2B berbasis di Bekasi. Kami menghubungkan pengembangan aplikasi, produk berlangganan, dan pengelolaan infrastruktur agar teknologi mendukung proses kerja serta pertumbuhan bisnis.
id.vision: Menjadi partner teknologi tepercaya yang membantu bisnis bertumbuh melalui solusi digital yang relevan, aman, dan dapat dioperasikan secara berkelanjutan.
mission: Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi website, aplikasi, dan workflow yang mudah digunakan.
Menyiapkan dan memelihara server, database, serta jaringan dengan perubahan yang terukur.
Mengembangkan produk operasional dengan pemisahan data dan akses sesuai peran.
Menjaga kejelasan scope, dokumentasi, pengujian, dan handover dalam setiap pekerjaan.
id.experienceNote: Pengalaman teknis lintas proyek lebih dari 9 tahun; bukan keterangan tanggal pendirian badan usaha.

value.title: Satu konteks, end-to-end
value.copy: Development, deployment, database, dan operasional dipertimbangkan sebagai satu sistem, bukan pekerjaan yang terputus.

value.title: Teknologi yang proporsional
value.copy: Arsitektur dan stack mengikuti kebutuhan, kapasitas tim, risiko, serta biaya operasional.

value.title: Delivery yang jelas
value.copy: Ruang lingkup, asumsi, milestone, uji penerimaan, dan dukungan lanjutan dijelaskan dalam penawaran.

value.title: Privasi dan maintainability
value.copy: Akses dibatasi sesuai kebutuhan; dokumentasi, pemantauan, dan rencana pemulihan menjadi perhatian sejak awal.

services.title: Digital Product & Application Development
services.label: BUILD
services.summary: Website dan aplikasi bisnis yang dirancang mengikuti pengguna, proses operasional, dan identitas perusahaan.
scope: Website, landing page, dan CMS
Web application, CRM, dan dashboard
Aplikasi Android dan iOS sesuai kebutuhan
Backend, database, integrasi API, serta UI/UX
services.outcome: Dari discovery dan desain hingga testing, deployment, dan handover.

services.title: Managed Infrastructure & IT Operations
services.label: OPERATE
services.summary: Pemeliharaan dan visibilitas infrastruktur untuk membantu tim menjaga kontinuitas layanan.
scope: Administrasi server dan patch terjadwal
Monitoring server, jaringan, endpoint, dan TLS
Database maintenance serta peninjauan kapasitas
Verifikasi backup, restore support, dan incident support
services.outcome: Pemeriksaan dan laporan teknis sesuai ruang lingkup layanan.

services.title: Remote IT, Migration & Server Hardening
services.label: DEPLOY & SECURE
services.summary: Pekerjaan teknis berbasis scope untuk instalasi, migrasi, troubleshooting, dan penguatan konfigurasi.
scope: Instalasi Linux, web stack, dan database
Migrasi website, aplikasi, database, dan mail server
Konfigurasi DNS, TLS, serta autentikasi email
Hardening, review akses, cutover, dan rencana rollback
services.outcome: Perubahan bertahap, pengujian, dokumentasi, dan handover yang terarah.

services.title: VPS & Cloud Server
services.label: INFRASTRUCTURE
services.summary: Pilihan resource virtual dan dedicated yang disesuaikan dengan karakter workload dan kebutuhan bisnis.
scope: RDS Lite, RDS PRO, RDS Windows, dan RDS Dedicated
Sizing CPU, RAM, storage, dan sistem operasi
Pilihan Plesk, cPanel, atau tanpa control panel
Add-on storage, snapshot, serta backup sesuai penawaran
services.outcome: Harga melalui permintaan penawaran. Lisensi, SLA, backup, dan Manage Server mengikuti konfigurasi serta scope yang disepakati.

products.title: ReTendance / Attendance
products.summary: Aplikasi attendance untuk pencatatan kehadiran, izin/cuti, dan pengelolaan tim melalui aplikasi Android serta dashboard perusahaan.
features: Selfie, verifikasi wajah, GPS, dan geofence
Jadwal dan shift, termasuk lintas hari
Izin/cuti dengan alur persetujuan sesuai paket
Kalender, riwayat, laporan, dan akses berbasis peran
products.note: Paket Free, Pro, dan Bisnis. Kapasitas, lokasi, shift, serta tingkat persetujuan mengikuti paket. Verifikasi wajah dan sinyal perangkat membantu pemeriksaan, bukan jaminan bebas kecurangan.

products.title: RETECH QR Order & POS
products.summary: Solusi untuk cafe, restoran, dan coffee shop yang menghubungkan menu digital, pemesanan, kasir, serta laporan operasional.
features: Menu digital dan QR per meja
Alur kasir dan transaksi sesuai scope pilot
products.note: Rollout dilakukan bertahap melalui pilot. Ketersediaan fitur, kebutuhan outlet, perangkat, payment gateway, dan integrasi dikonfirmasi sebelum implementasi; bukan klaim seluruh fitur telah tersedia umum.

id.subscriptionNote: Setiap customer memiliki workspace dan akses sesuai peran. Aktivasi atau perpanjangan mengikuti pembayaran yang telah diverifikasi serta ketentuan paket. Onboarding, kapasitas, dan kebutuhan khusus dikonfirmasi bersama tim melalui quotation atau invoice.
id.privacyNote: Identitas klien, logo, kontak, alamat, dan data operasional rahasia tidak ditampilkan. Visual merupakan ilustrasi konseptual, bukan screenshot data customer. Informasi proyek disajikan secara ringkas dengan tetap menjaga kerahasiaan klien.

cases.outcome: Data kehadiran dan proses persetujuan lebih mudah ditinjau oleh pengelola berwenang.

process.title: Discover & Assess
process.copy: Memetakan tujuan, pengguna, aset, dependensi, risiko, dan kondisi awal.

process.title: Scope & Plan
process.copy: Menyepakati deliverable, asumsi, batas pekerjaan, jadwal, serta biaya melalui quotation/SOW.

process.title: Build & Verify
process.copy: Menjalankan implementasi bertahap, pengujian fungsi penting, dan validasi bersama customer.

process.title: Launch & Operate
process.copy: Deployment/cutover, dokumentasi, handover, serta dukungan lanjutan sesuai kesepakatan.

en.intro: PT. Retech Digital Solution (RETECH) is a B2B technology partner based in Bekasi, Indonesia. We connect application development, subscription products, and infrastructure operations so technology supports daily work and business growth.
en.vision: To be a trusted technology partner that helps businesses grow through relevant, secure digital solutions that can be operated sustainably.
mission: Translate business needs into usable websites, applications, and workflows.
Prepare and maintain servers, databases, and networks through controlled changes.
Develop operational products with data separation and role-based access.
Keep scope, documentation, testing, and handover clear throughout delivery.
en.experienceNote: More than 9 years of technical experience across projects; not the incorporation date of the legal entity.

value.title: One context, end to end
value.copy: Development, deployment, databases, and operations are considered as one system rather than disconnected tasks.

value.title: Proportionate technology
value.copy: Architecture and technology follow requirements, team capacity, risks, and operating costs.

value.title: Clear delivery
value.copy: Scope, assumptions, milestones, acceptance tests, and ongoing support are explained in the proposal.

value.title: Privacy and maintainability
value.copy: Access is limited to need; documentation, monitoring, and recovery planning are considered from the start.

services.title: Digital Product & Application Development
services.label: BUILD
services.summary: Business websites and applications designed around users, operational processes, and brand identity.
scope: Websites, landing pages, and CMS
Web applications, CRM, and dashboards
Android and iOS applications to fit the requirement
Backend, databases, API integration, and UI/UX
services.outcome: From discovery and design to testing, deployment, and handover.

services.title: Managed Infrastructure & IT Operations
services.label: OPERATE
services.summary: Infrastructure maintenance and visibility to help teams maintain service continuity.
scope: Server administration and scheduled patching
Server, network, endpoint, and TLS monitoring
Database maintenance and capacity review
Backup verification, restore support, and incident support
services.outcome: Technical checks and reporting within the agreed service scope.

services.title: Remote IT, Migration & Server Hardening
services.label: DEPLOY & SECURE
services.summary: Scope-based technical work for installation, migration, troubleshooting, and configuration hardening.
scope: Linux, web stack, and database installation
Website, application, database, and mail-server migration
DNS, TLS, and email authentication configuration
Hardening, access review, cutover, and rollback planning
services.outcome: Controlled changes, testing, documentation, and a clear handover.

services.title: VPS & Cloud Server
services.label: INFRASTRUCTURE
services.summary: Virtual and dedicated resource options selected for the workload and business requirements.
scope: RDS Lite, RDS PRO, RDS Windows, and RDS Dedicated
CPU, RAM, storage, and operating-system sizing
Optional Plesk, cPanel, or no control panel
Storage, snapshots, and backup add-ons by quotation
services.outcome: Pricing is quotation-based. Licenses, SLA, backup, and Manage Server follow the selected configuration and agreed scope.

products.title: ReTendance / Attendance
products.summary: An attendance application for daily attendance, leave requests, and team administration through Android and a company dashboard.
features: Selfies, face verification, GPS, and geofencing
Schedules and shifts, including overnight work
Leave requests with plan-based approval levels
Calendar, history, reporting, and role-based access
products.note: Free, Pro, and Business plans. Employee capacity, locations, shifts, and approval levels follow the selected plan. Face and device checks support review, not a guarantee of zero fraud.

products.title: RETECH QR Order & POS
products.summary: A solution for cafes, restaurants, and coffee shops that connects digital menus, ordering, cashier workflows, and operational reporting.
features: Digital menus and table QR codes
Cashier and transaction workflows within pilot scope
products.note: Rollout follows a phased pilot. Feature availability, outlets, devices, payment gateways, and integrations are confirmed before implementation; this does not claim every feature is generally available.

en.subscriptionNote: Each customer has a workspace and role-based access. Activation and renewal follow verified payments and the selected plan. Onboarding, capacity, and custom needs are confirmed with the team through a quotation or invoice.
en.privacyNote: Confidential client identities, logos, contacts, addresses, and operational records are not shown. Visuals are conceptual illustrations, not customer-data screenshots. Project information is summarized while respecting client confidentiality.

process.title: Discover & Assess
process.copy: Map goals, users, assets, dependencies, risks, and the starting condition.

process.title: Scope & Plan
process.copy: Agree deliverables, assumptions, boundaries, schedule, and cost through a quotation/SOW.

process.title: Build & Verify
process.copy: Implement in stages, test important functions, and validate with the customer.

process.title: Launch & Operate
process.copy: Deploy or cut over, document, hand over, and support within the agreed scope.
